matches.rationale: Finding 2 directly targets the (PI)/(DI) formulation in Section 4.1, identifying inconsistent constraint handling (box vs equality constraints) and a mismatch with Algorithm 1's update/projection steps, which is exactly the kind of primal-dual misalignment described in GT1.

No finding discusses Assumption 1's removal of boundedness/Lipschitz conditions on the non-equivariant branch or the resulting vacuity of Theorems 4.1/4.2; Finding 5, though touching Theorem 4.2, instead flags a constant/exponent mismatch between the theorem and appendix, a distinct issue (R4).
